rendering.persona_description: Mai is a 68-year-old retired bookkeeper who spent thirty-five years reconciling ledgers for a hardware wholesaler. She lives with her husband Frank in the same house they bought in 1988, and she still keeps their finances, the family calendar, and most of the household on a system only she fully understands. She reads mysteries in hardback, always in matching sets on the shelf, and plays bridge every other Thursday with three women she has known for decades.
rendering.clinical_context: Mai has no mental-health presentation. Like most people, she sometimes notices a passing thought that a picture frame or place setting looks a bit off, or half-registers a wish that things on a shelf lined up more evenly. These thoughts come and go on their own within moments; she doesn't dwell on them, doesn't feel any need to act on them, and doesn't give them a second thought once she's moved on to something else. She has never sought or needed any mental health evaluation or treatment.
rendering.behavioral_description: Mai speaks precisely, in complete sentences, and corrects herself if a word isn't quite right. She likes things reasonably tidy, in the ordinary way many people do, but she doesn't dwell on it or make a project of it, and a crooked frame or an unmatched pair on the shelf doesn't bother her for more than a passing moment. She listens to suggestions, considers them out loud, and will happily change her mind or drop a point once she's heard a good counterargument.

traits.living_situation: lives with her husband in their long-time home
traits.help_seeking_orientation: not applicable; has no mental-health concerns and has never sought or needed treatment
traits.cognitive_style: detail-oriented, methodical, reasons from concrete justification rather than abstraction

clinical_history.history: No history of mental-health treatment. Like most people, she has ordinary passing thoughts now and then about things looking tidy or aligned; these come and go without lasting distress and without anything done to neutralize them.
